Philosophy

"The reason you don't have the career, finances, relationships or health that you want, isn't because you aren't working hard enough. It's not because you aren't good enough, smart enough or don't deserve it. It's because of the programming and negative beliefs that were given to you by teachers, parents and society. This programming controls every aspect of your life and dictates how the world responds and interacts with you, and you didn't choose it. Once we start to change this programming and remove the blocks in your way, everything starts to open up and you can finally align to the dream life that is meant for you."

— Jake Kelly

How It Works

Your journey, step by step

Step 01

Choose Your Session

Click the "Schedule A Session" button down below to fill out an interest form. Once Jake intuitively confirms the best option for you, you'll receive an email with available date and time options to choose from.

Step 02

Session Prep

Once your session is booked, you'll receive an email with the zoom link and a few questions to answer to help maximize your time together. Jake may also send you some pre-session readings or audios that will help further the session.

Step 03

The Session

Find a quiet, calm space that is free from distractions so you can get the most out of our time. The session will be recorded so you can go back and re watch at any time.

Step 04

Integration & Support

After the session, Jake will perform a personalized healing that is approved by your Higher Self and will help you fully align with the information in the session. Taking the right action will feel easier and things will start to flow in a way they haven't before.
